rows.description: My older sibling shouts and pushes me and I feel tiny and helpless. It is not my fault, and I should tell a parent when I am hurt. A wise parent stops the hurting and listens to both sides.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: forgiveness, loyalty, rivalry
paired view exists: Actor (S517)
related mind states: anger, hurt

rows.description: We race to be first for everything and both want Papa's attention. I feel proud when I win and crushed when I lose. Wise families let each child have their own special time and praise effort, not who is first.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, forgiveness, loyalty
related mind states: pride

rows.description: After we both cried, I hand my sibling a toy and say sorry. I feel light again. Saying sorry and doing something kind is a lovely repair, while forced sorry with no feeling teaches only how to say the word.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, loyalty, rivalry
related mind states: affection

rows.description: On the playground someone bothers my brother and I stand next to him even though we fought at home. Sibling love can be stronger than sibling fights. Wise loyalty means telling a teacher, not fighting.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, forgiveness, rivalry
related mind states: affection

rows.description: My parent says "you are older, you should know better" and I feel it is unfair. I sulk. A wise parent hears both children before deciding. Blaming the older child always teaches resentment.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, forgiveness, loyalty, rivalry
related mind states: resentment

rows.description: I like the girl next to me and ask "do you want to play?" My heart is thumping but she says yes. I feel brave and happy. Making the first move kindly, even shyly, is the start of friendship.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: dependence, jealousy, loyalty
related mind states: joy, affection, shyness

rows.description: I want to join but stand at the edge, waiting for someone to notice me. A wise adult helps me practise "can I play too?" Shyness is not weakness and grows lighter with a few safe tries.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, dependence, jealousy, loyalty
related mind states: shyness, trust

rows.description: My friend says "you are my best friend" and saves me a seat. I feel special and secure. I learn friendship means being chosen and choosing back, and I try to be kind and keep secrets kindly.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, dependence, jealousy
related mind states: trust

rows.description: I cry when my best friend is absent and will not play with anyone else. Close attachment is sweet but I also need other friends. A wise adult helps me to join a small group so my world does not depend on one child.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, jealousy, loyalty
related mind states: sadness

rows.description: My friend plays with a new girl and I feel a burning in my chest. I say "she is not allowed to play". Wise action: say "I felt sad" and invite both to play. Excluding someone to keep a friend is the harmful pattern.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, dependence, loyalty
related mind states: sadness, jealousy
